bio.text: Angel Oakley is the Republican candidate for Illinois' 3rd Congressional District in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Delia Ramirez.
She earned a bachelor's degree and a master's degree from Judson University in 2004 and 2013, and also graduated from the Illinois Institute of Art.
Her career experience includes working as a technology and consulting startup founder, a management consultant and an adjunct instructor.
